+\"\"\"Minimal OpenAI Responses API client using only Python's standard library.\"\"\"
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence
+from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+DEFAULT_API_URL = \"https://api.openai.com/v1/responses\"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = \"gpt-5-mini\"
+DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60.0
+
+
+class OpenAIError(RuntimeError):
+    \"\"\"Raised when a Responses API request cannot be completed.\"\"\"
+
+
+class OpenAIClient:
+    \"\"\"Send plain-text prompts to the OpenAI Responses API.\"\"\"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        api_key: str | None = None,
+        model: str | None = None,
+        *,
+        api_url: str = DEFAULT_API_URL,
+        timeout: float = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_API_KEY\")
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise OpenAIError(
+                \"No API key provided. Set OPENAI_API_KEY or pass api_key.\"
+            )
+
+        self.model = model or os.environ.get(\"OPENAI_MODEL\") or DEFAULT_MODEL
+        self.api_url = api_url
+        self.timeout = timeout
+
+    def send_prompt(
+        self,
+        prompt: str,
+        *,
+        model: str | None = None,
+        store: bool = False,
+        timeout: float | None = None,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        \"\"\"Send one private text prompt and return the decoded API response.\"\"\"
+        if not isinstance(prompt, str) or not prompt.strip():
+            raise ValueError(\"prompt must be a non-empty string\")
+        if timeout is not None and timeout <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(\"timeout must be greater than zero\")
+
+        payload = {
+            \"model\": model or self.model,
+            \"input\": prompt,
+            \"store\": store,
+        }
+        request = Request(
+            self.api_url,
+            data=json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\"),
+            headers={
+                \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self.api_key}\",
+                \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
+                \"Accept\": \"application/json\",
+                \"User-Agent\": \"openai-client/1.0\",
+            },
+            method=\"POST\",
+        )
+
+        try:
+            with urlopen(request, timeout=timeout or self.timeout) as response:
+                body = response.read().decode(\"utf-8\")
+        except HTTPError as error:
+            raise _http_error(error) from None
+        except (TimeoutError, URLError) as error:
+            reason = getattr(error, \"reason\", error)
+            raise OpenAIError(f\"Network request failed: {reason}\") from None
+        except OSError as error:
+            raise OpenAIError(f\"Could not read the API response: {error}\") from None
+
+        try:
+            decoded = json.loads(body)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            raise OpenAIError(\"The API returned invalid JSON\") from None
+        if not isinstance(decoded, dict):
+            raise OpenAIError(\"The API returned an unexpected JSON value\")
+        return decoded
+
+
+def response_text(response: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    \"\"\"Extract text output from a Responses API response.\"\"\"
+    text_parts: list[str] = []
+    for item in response.get(\"output\", []):
+        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            continue
+        for content in item.get(\"content\", []):
+            if (
+                isinstance(content, Mapping)
+                and content.get(\"type\") == \"output_text\"
+                and isinstance(content.get(\"text\"), str)
+            ):
+                text_parts.append(content[\"text\"])
+    return \"\\n\".join(text_parts)
+
+
+def _http_error(error: HTTPError) -> OpenAIError:
+    detail = \"\"
+    try:
+        raw_body = error.read().decode(\"utf-8\")
+        decoded: Any = json.loads(raw_body)
+        api_error = decoded.get(\"error\", decoded)
+        if isinstance(api_error, Mapping):
+            message = api_error.get(\"message\")
+            error_type = api_error.get(\"type\")
+            code = api_error.get(\"code\")
+            fields = [
+                str(value)
+                for label, value in (
+                    (\"message\", message),
+                    (\"type\", error_type),
+                    (\"code\", code),
+                )
+                if value is not None
+            ]
+            detail = \" — \" + \" | \".join(fields)
+    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
+        pass
+    return OpenAIError(f\"API request failed with HTTP {error.code}{detail}\")
+
+
+def _parse_args(argv: Sequence[str] | None) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description=\"Send a private text prompt to OpenAI's Responses API.\"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        \"prompt\",
+        nargs=\"*\",
+        help=\"Prompt text; omit it (or use '-') to read from standard input.\",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(\"--model\", help=\"Model to use (or set OPENAI_MODEL).\")
+    parser.add_argument(
+        \"--timeout\",
+        type=float,
+        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT,
+        help=f\"Request timeout in seconds (default: {DEFAULT_TIMEOUT:g}).\",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        \"--json\",
+        action=\"store_true\",
+        help=\"Print the complete JSON response instead of response text.\",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        \"--store\",
+        action=\"store_true\",
+        help=\"Allow OpenAI to store the response; disabled by default.\",
+    )
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = _parse_args(argv)
+    prompt_parts = args.prompt
+    if not prompt_parts or prompt_parts == [\"-\"]:
+        prompt = sys.stdin.read()
+    else:
+        prompt = \" \".join(prompt_parts)
+
+    try:
+        client = OpenAIClient(model=args.model, timeout=args.timeout)
+        result = client.send_prompt(prompt, store=args.store)
+    except (OpenAIError, ValueError) as error:
+        print(f\"error: {error}\", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    if args.json:
+        json.dump(result, sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+        sys.stdout.write(\"\\n\")
+    else:
+        output = response_text(result)
+        if output:
+            print(output)
+        else:
+            print(\"The API response contained no text output.\", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == \"__main__\":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
